conviction_note: Shochiku has revised its full-year plan at every results print in FY26/2, all released at 14:00. It reported Q1 operating profit of 1,729m, 46.7% of a 3,700m plan. TOHO's own cinema series ran -9.5% in Jun-Aug against last year's boom quarter, while Shochiku's own distributed films did well (黒牢城 passed 10億 in a month; the あの星 sequel opened ahead of a 45億 predecessor). That puts H1 operating profit near or above the full-year plan, so an upward revision at 14:00 today is likely. But the only consensus (IFIS ordinary 5,275m, one broker) already sits about 50% above the plan, and last October Shochiku set the revised full year roughly equal to H1. The revised number may therefore land at or slightly below consensus. That leaves a modest positive lean (p_up 58) on a widened scale (abs 5.0, against a proxy of 3.88 and H1 reactions of -10.4 and +12.4 in the last two years). impact_sum +1.1 and expected_move +0.8 agree in sign.
bar: IFIS consensus FY27/2 ordinary profit 5,275m (company plan 3,500m), with consensus target price 13,100. The consensus is effectively one broker: Tokai Tokyo, Outperform, target raised 13,000->13,100 on 2026-09-10. Sources: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportTop?bcode=9601 and https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9601&b=n202609101007. The bar is single-source, so the guidance finding is capped.

That is squeeze fuel on good news. No options and no skew. Run-up is -0.37% over 20 days and +1.31% over 5. priced_lean is +0.061.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit is likely 3.7-5.0bn yen (Q1 1,729m plus a Q2 of about 2.0-3.3bn), at or above the 3,700m full-year plan. Shochiku has revised at every results print in FY26/2, so an upward revision with today's 14:00 release is likely. Last October it set the revised full year roughly equal to H1 (H1 OP 4,249 -> FY 4,300), so the revised ordinary profit may land at about 4.6-5.5bn against a 5,275m consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last two H1 prints: 2024-10-11 -10.36% (H1 OP 715) and 2025-10-15 +12.37% (FY ordinary raised 50% on a surprise H1). Other revisions were not reliably bought: 2025-07-15 net +45% -2.59%, 2026-01-14 ordinary +27% -2.04%. The 2026-07-14 Q1 (47% progress, plan held) went +3.88%. All from the baseline's estimated-cadence history, with the dates matching kabutan's results headlines.
findings.why_not_priced: The plan itself is clearly not the bar: the stock trades at 67.8x plan EPS and the one consensus number is about 50% above the plan, so 'there will be a revision' is mostly in the price. What is not observable yet is its size against 5,275m. If the market expected a revision well above consensus, the stock would have moved toward the 13,100 target in the last 20 sessions; it is flat (-0.37%), and margin shorts exceed margin longs, so nobody is crowded long into the print. The Q2 inputs (TOHO's monthly box office series, film grosses) are public but have not been turned into a published Shochiku H1 number.
findings.independence: Three different documents feed the H1 estimate. (1) TOHO's own cinema series, Jun-Aug 2026: 4,936/8,340/9,797m against 5,823/9,096/10,583m, -9.5% (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261009/140120260929542010.pdf). Shochiku's MOVIX tracked it within 1pt in Q1 FY27 (+10.1% vs +9.4%) and Q2 FY26 (+64% vs +63%) per Shochiku's Q1 deck (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592605.pdf). (2) Shochiku-distributed hits: 黒牢城 passed 10億 in a month (https://realsound.jp/book/2026/07/post-2470558.html); the あの星 sequel opened ahead of its 45億 predecessor (https://movie.jorudan.co.jp/news/jrd_260810_01/). (3) The prior conservative-revision pattern (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251015/140120251014573061.pdf). The counterweight sits inside this one finding, not in a second one: Q2 FY26 OP was a very high 3,158 and the Osaka Shochikuza farewell boost to Q1 演劇 (1,351m) does not repeat after the theatre closed in May.

findings.finding: Q1 映像関連 segment profit collapsed to 16m from 416m even though the theatres grew 10%, because distribution revenue fell 53% and corporate costs rose 124m. A Q2 映像 margin near Q1's would cap H1, though this is already public.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Public since 2026-07-14; the stock rose 3.88% that day on the headline operating profit, so the segment mix was looked through.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it sits in the last 短信 and anyone can compute it. The only unpriced part is whether Q2 repeats it, and the Q2 distribution slate (黒牢城, あの星) argues it does not. Sized near zero for that reason.
findings.independence: Same Q1 deck as finding 1's segment base; it shares a document, not a conclusion. Nothing independent points the same way.

outside_window.finding: The 博多STビル sale, with a planned 4,500m extraordinary gain already in the FY net plan, had no contract disclosed by 2026-10-14. It resolves whenever the contract is signed, with no date set.

baseline_tension: The lean is mildly positive and agrees with the baseline's small positive lean and the margin-short-heavy setup, so it is not contrarian. The strongest negative is the reverse case: a below-consensus revised guide, or a Q2 YoY profit drop headline. The strongest positive is a raise above 5,275 with a better H2 from the あの星 run; both were looked for.
